notes.title: Spirit Of The North 2 | OUT NOW 🦊
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Guardians! 🦊[/h2]

The moment we’ve all been waiting for is finally here - [b]Spirit of the North 2 is officially out now on Steam![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/3f382957d86fc9860dc5640c3cb81907887cedda.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=GrZz-2IdQTM;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/3f382957d86fc9860dc5640c3cb81907887cedda.png[/img]
Whether you’ve been with us since the first game or joined along the way, we can’t thank you enough for your support, your feedback, and your patience.

Now, it’s your turn to step into this beautiful, mysterious world once again - this time, with new powers, new companions, and a world that’s bigger and more alive than ever before.

Here’s what’s waiting for you:

🦊[b] Play as the Spirit Fox[/b] - Reawaken ancient powers, explore a vast world, and uncover the fate of the lost guardians.

🐦 [b]You’re not alone[/b] - Team up with a wise raven companion in your journey to cleanse corruption and bring balance back to the land.

🌌[b]Stunning environments[/b] - From lush valleys to snow-covered peaks, every inch of this world is crafted with care using Unreal Engine 5.

⚔️ [b]Boss encounters & puzzles[/b] - Battle corrupted guardian spirits and solve ancient puzzles to restore the realm.

🎨 [b]Customization[/b] - Find and equip new skins and power-enhancing runes to shape your fox’s journey your way.

You’ve followed us through development, shared our excitement, and kept the spirit alive - now it’s time to experience the magic for yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/01e9a350d3254e012702dcb0e9b33f30ed43a6a6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/3f382957d86fc9860dc5640c3cb81907887cedda.png[/img]
➡️[b] Launch day is just the beginning[/b]. We’ll be keeping an eye out for your thoughts, feedback, and favorite moments. Don’t forget to share your screenshots, theories, and discoveries in the Community Hub!

[b]From all of us  - thank you, and we hope you enjoy the journey.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/3f382957d86fc9860dc5640c3cb81907887cedda.png[/img]

notes.title: Spirit of the North 2 | Developer Diary #4 - Music & Lore
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, Guardians![/h3]

We're excited to bring you [b]Dev Diary #4: Music & Lore![/b]

In today’s diary, Tayler is joined by composer Pav Gekko for a deeper look into the emotional heart of Spirit of the North 2 - its music.

From quiet snowfall to ancient ruins wrapped mystery, every note in the world of Spirit of the North 2 is designed to guide and connect. Pav shares his approach to creating a soundtrack that doesn’t just accompany your journey - it becomes part of it.

Each region you explore has its own musical identity, woven with care to reflect its story, its spirits, and the feeling of being truly lost… and then found again. Whether you're wandering through moonlit valleys or chasing the trail of a lost Guardian, the music is always there - quietly shaping the way you feel.

And yes, there may just be a few musical secrets hidden in the wind. 🎶

We can't wait for you to hear more.

notes.title: Developer Diary #2 - Region Introduction #1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/a74bb52b37f27eb6991607ee0f414ff86a0baebd.jpg[/img]
Hey everyone!

We continue our Dev Diary series by introducing 3 of the 6 Regions in Spirit of the North 2!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/3f382957d86fc9860dc5640c3cb81907887cedda.png[/img]

[h2]Misthaven[/h2]
A lonely landscape shrouded in mist. Hidden in this eerie region are the ruins of a tribe that revered the White Raven Guardian.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/80a535eaa4ff3b8fbbbe308bf9923413601cba1a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/ede6da16714df857980f3405b78735cf09302fad.jpg[/img]


[h2]Mosswood[/h2]
A vast forested region teeming with beauty and life. The people here were prosperous under the watchful care of the Stag Guardian.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/9f01f984ce8b507c2d3aeefd95c7b6ddcf843964.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/c30da9298b4771364c8d6d7c387f7e8625bcb23b.jpg[/img]

[h2]Ashlands[/h2]
A once peaceful volcanic region now lays desolate, filled with ruins of a tribe that worshiped the powerful Bear Guardian and chose to awaken him.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/0b22ee4dd6db68693d1bc8f45ffcd1a7d77f6a1f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/2ea666761e346e25acb6460a248e59d8511cdc59.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/3f382957d86fc9860dc5640c3cb81907887cedda.png[/img]


Each region has new runes, relics, Guardian Temples, scrolls, abilities and various mysterious encounters. There are many more areas you can look forward to exploring in Spirit of the North 2 which goes beyond the Nordic landscapes in the first Spirit of the North!

notes.title: Developer Diary #1 - World Introduction
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/9872151248fcbfe2297c56395551a2a85e4b1822.jpg[/img]
Hey everyone!

We're going to kick off a series of dev blog updates to give you more insight into the world of Spirit of the North and give some sneak peeks into what you'll have in store on the epic journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/3f382957d86fc9860dc5640c3cb81907887cedda.png[/img]

[h2]The Fox[/h2]
In Spirit of the North 2, you step into the paws of an entirely new fox from the protagonist of the first game. Taking in feedback from the first game, the fox character has been completely rebuilt from the ground up, with an updated look and a newly designed movement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/131edca9237156390eb7e7364f90f9127e10aa2c.png[/img]

[h2]The Raven[/h2]
Joining you for this adventure is your new companion, Thought, a wise Raven who will help guide you on your journey and aid you in traversing this new world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/ea2652003144c884dd64cbdcda41596141e5bab7.jpg[/img]

[h2]The World[/h2]
Those who played the original Spirit of the North will be familiar with the icy Nordic-inspired landscapes they had to navigate. For Spirit of the North 2, we're going much bigger with the game world and sending players off to discover a variety of different regions, each with its own flavor featuring unique weather patterns. 

Additionally, the move to Unreal Engine 5 has given us a range of tools to enhance the handcrafted world, bringing more detailed lighting and effects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/56252e2987d957e99c361b1688351b84c7dea136.png[/img]

[h2]Abilities[/h2]
Players will discover runes along the journey that they can equip to change appearance and grant them abilities. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/5e0234ad3822b31ed613eafd216265a037e2b491.jpg[/img]

[h2]Music[/h2]
It wouldn't be a SOTN game without emotionally stirring music and immersive sound effects. This has been a major focus and our composer has truly elevated the experience of exploring the various landscapes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/7fb374cfe2259628fffbe27e6823f86b52b22975.jpg[/img]

We are excited for you to experience the beautiful journey of Spirit of the North 2.
Stay tuned for more updates from us over the upcoming months!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44719848/3f382957d86fc9860dc5640c3cb81907887cedda.png[/img]


Wishlist Spirit of the North 2 now on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1778840/Spirit_of_the_North_2/

notes.title: Spirit of the North: Enhanced Edition Update
notes.content:
[h3]Hey Everyone![/h3]

Before diving into the patch details we just wanted to say a quick thank you to all of you for the amazing and continued support for everything Spirit of the North! We love taking some time out to have a look through the community hub here on Steam to see all the new fan art and screenshots - Credit to ‘My name is you.’ for the header artwork we’ve picked out for this post!

Today we’re excited to be releasing a new patch which brings the graphics on Spirit of the North in line with our release of Spirit of the North: Enhanced Edition which launched on console last year.
As soon as you’ve updated your game, you’ll be able to jump in and make the most of the updated graphics, as well as being able to play with a new furry-faced friend, the ‘Vixen’ skin.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36827189/f798c18b6a0cb0549df2c045893ca7c05ba4aba8.png[/img]Say hello to the newest member of the family!

Introducing the new ‘vixen’ skin, a gorgeous girl with a more subtle orange fur tone to her counterpart. She’s available from the start of the game and isn’t needed to be unlocked, so whether you’re new to Spirit of the North or a returning player she’s waiting to join you on your journey.

Just hit the menu button, got to rewards to swap over to this new skin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36827189/19c996b3dad90e7bd7fad2c1020d1517a2c0d026.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36827189/d73e70b48a2f342dd0088635284dd2f91c4850ca.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36827189/342b9e9a02bf6fa48100200c497ca08cd8fc7747.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Moss Foliage
[*] Improved Lighting
[*] Improved Shadow Distribution
[*] Improved Snow Material
[*] Improved Rock and Cliff Materials
[*] Ultra-Setting now has farther foliage draw distance and LOD Bias for Static Meshes
[/list]

Don’t forget to join the Spirit of the North [url=https://discord.gg/7z7PfeyruF]Discord [/url] or to follow us on Social media: [url=https://twitter.com/PlaySOTN]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/PlaySpiritOfTheNorth/]Facebook[/url]

notes.title: Korean language update - 언어 업데이트

We're pleased to announce that we've updated Spirit of the North to include Korean language support!

Thank you to anyone whose first language is Koren and has been looking forward to a language update. We hope you enjoy the game!

notes.title: Update 1.05
notes.content:
We have a great small update for you all!

Update 1.05 removes the Ambient Occlusion ghosting and artifacts that appeared on the Foxes fur when moving.

Take a look at the video we put together below to show the difference.
[previewyoutube=P9yo0tD-yTo;full][/previewyoutube]

We have been trying to figure out how to fix the issue with the fur for a long time and are really excited to finally have it fixed for you all!

The update is now live on Steam and is coming soon to consoles.

notes.title: Update 1.04 Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36827189/215768ff05bbf279ec8fdf3fd9736535e6aebd0d.jpg[/img]
[h2]We are happy to announce that our biggest update yet is now live![/h2] 

[h3]We have added, improved, and overhauled so much in this update based on feedback from our awesome community. A BIG shoutout to everyone that tried the beta![/h3]

Here is a video we put together showing some of the new features.
[previewyoutube=lL2yvBuHng8;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Also, consider joining us on the Spirit of the North Discord Server to chat with fans and the devs, plus we have custom fox emojis![/i]
https://discord.gg/sDhpZSg
[h3][b]Update 1.04 Release notes[/b][/h3]

[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36827189/3485a1f7112226951bcbd8aecf10534e31d9372b.jpg[/img]
[*]Photomode - Press 1 on the keyboard and D-Pad Down on the controller to enter Photomode and take awesome screenshots with ease!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36827189/7eb5631bfef2db3e5ff21ca908ce21d7a6216210.jpg[/img]
[*]3D Prompts UI - Instead of 2D prompts on the bottom left of the screen we now have 3D prompts that show up on a usable object.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36827189/f2f766ed81e9e563b4948e5db8c13d0232e2157b.jpg[/img]
[*]Wisp Overhaul - the Wisp is now much more helpful to the player by chirping near objectives and leading the way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36827189/ea299069bd052f48a0c4e36f95944ce8ab9bc1c6.jpg[/img]
[*]Spirit Dash - now leaves a glowing trail behind.

[*]Fox Stamina - You can now run as long as you want without having to slow down.

[*]PC Controls - We have added Bark/Spirit Bark to Left Click on the Mouse and Tail Wag to Right Click when using a keyboard and mouse on PC. This makes it much easier to move while barking and tail wagging.
[/list]
[h3]General[/h3]
[list]

[*]Improvement - Music selected in each Chapter now appropriately fits the mood. Playlists offer more variety throughout the whole game.

[*]Improvement - Checkboxes on the options menu are now easier to see.

[*]Improvement - Player can no longer Jump when in the “Sick” state. 

[*]Improvement - Dying in Chapter 1, 2, and 6 now drops staff if you are holding one.

[*]Improvement - Fox can no longer Sneeze while dying in Chapter 1.

[*]Improvement - Xbox control images have been updated to better ones.

[*]Improvement - Blueprint optimization overhaul, the game is overall much more optimized in terms of what is always loaded into memory.

[*]Improvement - Change Music can no longer be triggered while in Spirit Form.

[*]Improvement - Change music trigger won't change the music if the desired loop is already playing (won’t randomly turn it off and back on).

[*]Fixed - Issue that caused all shaman icons to show up on Chapter 7 and 8 where there should be none on the chapter select screen.

[*]Fixed - Japanese localization issues.

[*]Fixed - Issue that caused the foxes' mouth to be stuck open if the player was holding a Staff and entered Spirit Form.

[*]Fixed - Releasing Spirit Bark while transitioning back to foxes body from spirit form would cause player to get stuck "charged up".  Spirit Bark is now automatically released when spirit form ends.
[/list] 

[h3]Chapter Specific[/h3]
[list]
[b]Chapter 3[/b]
[*]Fixed - Removed L_thumbstick prompt at end of Chapter_03

[b]Chapter 4[/b]
[*]Fixed -Part 4 now loads much more efficiently, causing less stuttering.

[*]Fixed - Part 5 ground pressure plate jump gate was broken.

[b]Chapter 5 [/b]
[*]Fixed - Issue that caused music to stop playing at the start of the chapter.

[b]Chapter 6[/b]
[*]Improvement - Dramatic changes to the music in Chapter  6.

[*]Fixed - Dashing at certain times could cause the Wisp to not progress through the level correctly.

[*]Fixed - Wisp returned to fox during the middle of the chapter.

[b]Chapter 7[/b]
[*]Improvement - Shaman Spirits are less likely to get stuck while walking around. 

[*]Improvement - After healing spirit fox in Chapter 7 large stone gate opens, (players can no longer open it and go through without healing spirit fox).

[*]Fixed - Issue with some tree shadows disappearing at certain camera angles.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.04 Beta Test Event!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36827189/f92b1cfdd59109cfe917842daf37b718a22f7b41.jpg[/img]
[h2]We would like to invite everyone to participate in our Beta Update Event![/h2] 

[h3]This event is to allow our amazing community to help find bugs or stability issues with this new update before it goes live to everyone. You also get access to Photomode before everyone else![/h3]

To participate in this beta, you must own the Spirit of the North and follow the steps below:
[list][*] Launch Steam
[*] Navigate to your [b]library[/b]
[*] [b]Right-Click on Spirit of the North[/b]
[*] Choose [b]Properties[/b]
[*] Navigate to the [b]Betas[/b] tab
[*] [b]Expand the dropdown box[/b]
[*] Choose the [b]public_update_beta_branch[/b] option
[*] Click the [b]Close[/b] button[/list]

If this has been completed correctly, the game should automatically start to update.

To submit bug reports please use the following link. 
https://forms.gle/wQr1SrHhpNaU3tcd8

Also, consider joining us on the Spirit of the North Discord Server to chat with fans and the devs, plus we have custom fox emojis. 
https://discord.gg/sDhpZSg

General

notes.title: The Key Features of Spirit of the North!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36827189/607c184972e097cba617da6c19191dd8c462b5c1.jpg[/img]

Hi all, hope you're well! 

Today we wanted to take a little bit of time to introduce you to [i]Spirit of the North[/i] and outline some of the game's key features:

[i]Awaken… begin a quiet journey of discovery and companionship after rousing the slumbering Spirit of the North. 
[/i]
• Make your way across stunning landscapes, on an emotionally stirring journey.

• Solve environmental puzzles to change the world around you, using ancient powers bestowed upon you by the guardian of the Northern Lights.

• Follow the mysterious Spirit Fox across a land left in ruin as you discover more about a lost civilization.

• Moving orchestral soundtrack featuring 14 original compositions.

[i]Spirit of the North [/i]is coming soon to Steam!
